room_rent.note: Room Rent, Boarding, Nursing Expenses up to 1% of Sum Insured per day

icu.note: ICU/ICCU charges up to 2% of Sum Insured per day

copayment.note: Mandatory 20% co-pay on every admissible claim; can be waived by paying additional optional premium

sub_limits.note: Cataract capped at ₹40,000 per eye per year; Modern Treatments capped at 50% of Sum Insured; Room rent and ICU also sub-limited

initial_waiting.note: Except claims arising due to accident

ped_waiting.note: 24 months for pre-existing disability and HIV/AIDS; 36 months for all other pre-existing conditions

specific_disease_waiting.note: Applies to listed conditions including cataract, hernia, hysterectomy, benign tumors, etc.

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded under standard exclusion Code-Excl18

cumulative_bonus.note: No cumulative/no-claim bonus mentioned in the policy wording

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses for 30 days prior to admission

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses for 60 days from date of discharge

day_care.note: All day care treatments covered; extensive indicative list provided in Annexure III

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation explicitly excluded under specific exclusions

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to 100% of Sum Insured per policy year

organ_donor.note: Hospitalisation for donation of body organs by insured explicitly excluded

ambulance.note: Road ambulance expenses reimbursed up to ₹2,000 per hospitalisation

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments covered up to 50% of Sum Insured as inpatient or day care

consumables.note: Non-medical/consumable items listed in Annexure II List I are explicitly excluded

global_cover.note: Any medical treatment taken outside India is explicitly excluded

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage, claims cannot be contested except on grounds of established fraud

grace_period.note: 15 days grace for monthly premium payment mode; 30 days for all other modes

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only; not on renewals or porting/migration

portability.note: Portability allowed as per IRDAI guidelines with continuity of waiting period credits

notable_exclusions.display: Overseas treatment, organ donor hospitalisation, domiciliary, STDs (non-HIV), stem cell storage, ART for HIV, alternative therapies (acupuncture etc.)

optional_riders.display: Co-pay waiver (optional add-on to remove mandatory 20% co-payment)
